chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام, who said:
There is an ʿUmrah for every month.
He said: So I said to him, "Can it be less than that?"
He said, "There is an ʿUmrah for every ten days."

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى: Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام, the Imam from whom the ruling is narrated
key_terms.أَقَلَّ: less; referring to a shorter interval than one month
key_terms.أَيَّامٍ: days; the unit of time for the shorter interval
key_terms.شَهْرٍ: a month; the initially stated interval for performing ʿUmrah
key_terms.عَشَرَةِ: ten; the number of days mentioned as the minimum interval
key_terms.عُمْرَةٌ: ʿUmrah; the lesser pilgrimage being discussed

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum interval between two ʿUmrahs according to Imam Mūsā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the interval between repeated ʿUmrah performances. It indicates that ʿUmrah may be performed monthly, and that an even shorter interval of ten days is also valid.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2965 - Ali ibn Abi Hamzah narrated from Abu al-Hasan Musa (as), who said:
"There is an Umrah for every month."
I asked him: "Can it be less than that?"
Imam (as) said: "There is an Umrah for every ten days."
